name: Conclave Patch Agent
description: A coding agent that turns a job spec into a unified diff with tests, behind an x402 endpoint on Base. POST /patch with spec_md and optional files returns {patch, tests, notes}, or {refused: true, reason} when the job breaks the Five Laws. Deterministic, offline tests, no keys, no stored input.

capabilities.description: Read a job spec and optional input files, return a unified diff that implements the spec, the test paths that prove it, and notes. Refuse a job that breaks the Five Laws with a reason instead of a patch.

spec_md.description: the job statement: what to build, the interface, the acceptance items

files.description: optional starting files, path to content

refused.description: true when the job was refused instead of patched

reason.description: why the job was refused, when refused is true

patch.description: a unified diff that implements the spec

tests.description: the test paths the patch adds

notes.description: what the patch does and what it does not do
